description_en: Creates a search library to store media assets
description_zh: 用户新建搜索媒资库。可以用来保存媒资
name: CreateSearchLib

parameters.help_en: The name of the search library. The name can contain letters and digits. For IP camera (IPC) monitoring scenarios, the name must start with the `IPCamera_` prefix. For other scenarios, you can use a custom name
parameters.help_zh: 搜索库名称。数字字母组合。网络监控摄像头IPC场景前缀必须为"IPCamera_"，其他自定义即可
parameters.name: search_lib_name

parameters.help_en:
The configuration of the search library, in JSON string format. The fields include the following:

faceGroupIds: The IDs of custom face recognition libraries. You can create these libraries by calling the CreateRecognitionLib operation. You can specify up to three library IDs, separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
搜索库配置。JSON string格式。其中字段
faceGroupIds ：自注册人脸库ID，来着CreateRecognitionLib创建，最多支持3个自注册人脸库根据英文","拼接
parameters.name: search_lib_config
